words.enDefinition: an eye-care professional who examines vision and prescribes corrective lenses

examples.en: The optometrist compared my new results with the prescription I brought from home.
examples.zh: 「验光师」对照了这次检查的结果和我从家里带来的处方。

examples.en: I asked the optometrist for a written copy before leaving the eye clinic.
examples.zh: 离开眼科诊所前，我向「验光师」要了一份书面处方。

collocations: book an appointment with an optometrist

words.enDefinition: a physician who specializes in medical and surgical eye care

examples.en: The ophthalmologist showed me the images that had been taken during my appointment.
examples.zh: 「眼科医生」给我看了这次就诊时拍摄的影像。

examples.en: I asked the ophthalmologist who would send the report to my campus clinic.
examples.zh: 我问「眼科医生」会由谁把报告发给校医院。

words.enDefinition: a professional who fits and supplies glasses from a prescription

examples.en: The dispensing optician measured the frames after I brought in my prescription.
examples.zh: 我拿来处方后，「配镜师」量了镜框的尺寸。

examples.en: I asked the dispensing optician how the two frames differed in width.
examples.zh: 我问「配镜师」这两个镜框的宽度有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: a clinic that specializes in examining and caring for eyes

examples.en: I called the eye clinic from campus to check which entrance to use.
examples.zh: 我在学校给「眼科诊所」打了电话，确认该从哪个入口进去。

examples.en: The eye clinic shares a waiting room with another department across the hall.
examples.zh: 「眼科诊所」和走廊对面的另一个科室共用一间候诊室。

words.enDefinition: a store selling items such as glasses and contact lenses

examples.en: The optical shop near the bus stop had several frames within my budget.
examples.zh: 公交站附近的「眼镜店」有好几款在我预算内的镜框。

examples.en: I was able to collect my new frames at the optical shop after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我能到「眼镜店」取新镜框。

collocations: order glasses from an optical shop

words.enDefinition: an examination checking vision as well as overall eye health

examples.en: I asked how long the comprehensive eye exam would take before booking it.
examples.zh: 预约前我问了「全面眼部检查」大概要做多久。

examples.en: The clinic emailed a summary of my comprehensive eye exam the following morning.
examples.zh: 第二天早上，诊所用电子邮件把「全面眼部检查」的摘要发给了我。

words.enDefinition: a brief check for possible problems with sight

examples.en: The campus health fair offered vision screening in a quiet room upstairs.
examples.zh: 学校健康市集在楼上一间安静的房间提供了「视力筛查」。

examples.en: I brought the vision screening results to show what had already been checked.
examples.zh: 我带上「视力筛查」的结果，说明哪些项目已经检查过了。

words.enDefinition: the sharpness with which someone sees fine detail

examples.en: The report listed my visual acuity for each eye on a separate line.
examples.zh: 报告用两行分别记录了我每只眼睛的「视敏度」。

examples.en: I asked what visual acuity meant in the summary of my eye exam.
examples.zh: 我问眼部检查摘要里的「视敏度」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the ability to see details clearly at a distance

examples.en: The optometrist recorded my distance visual acuity before checking how well I read up close.
examples.zh: 「远视力」记录完后，验光师才检查我能不能看清近处的文字。

examples.en: My report listed distance visual acuity separately from the results of my reading test.
examples.zh: 报告把「远视力」和阅读测试的结果分开列出。

words.enDefinition: how clearly someone sees details at a close distance

examples.en: The examiner noted my near visual acuity after giving me a small reading card.
examples.zh: 检查人员递给我一张小阅读卡，然后记下我的「近视力」。

examples.en: I asked whether near visual acuity was the score printed beside the reading test.
examples.zh: 我问阅读测试旁边印的分数是不是「近视力」。

words.enDefinition: the vision someone has while using corrective lenses

examples.en: The report gave a figure for corrected vision when I was wearing my glasses.
examples.zh: 报告给出了我戴眼镜时的「矫正后视力」数值。

examples.en: I asked whether the figure for corrected vision was based on my current lenses.
examples.zh: 我问「矫正后视力」的那个数值是不是用我现在的镜片测的。

words.enDefinition: how well someone sees without glasses or contact lenses

examples.en: The assistant recorded my uncorrected vision before I put my glasses back on.
examples.zh: 我重新戴上眼镜前，助理记下了我的「裸眼视力」。

examples.en: The chart showed uncorrected vision separately from the results obtained with my glasses.
examples.zh: 表上把「裸眼视力」和我戴眼镜测出的结果分开列了。

collocations: compare uncorrected vision at different visits

words.enDefinition: a distance acuity measure matching standard clarity at twenty feet

examples.en: I asked what the 20/20 vision entry meant on my eye exam report.
examples.zh: 我问眼部检查报告上的「20/20视力」这一项是什么意思。

examples.en: The optometrist explained why 20/20 vision describes only one part of the exam.
examples.zh: 验光师解释了为什么「20/20视力」只代表检查的其中一部分。

words.enDefinition: a chart of symbols or letters for measuring visual clarity

examples.en: I could read the larger letters on the eye chart from across the room.
examples.zh: 从房间对面，我能看清「视力表」上较大的字母。

examples.en: The examiner asked which line on the eye chart looked the clearest to me.
examples.zh: 检查人员问我，在我看来「视力表」上哪一行最清楚。

collocations: a line on the eye chart

words.enDefinition: a letter chart with rows of decreasing sizes for acuity testing

examples.en: The examiner pointed to a row of letters halfway down the Snellen chart.
examples.zh: 检查人员指着「斯内伦视力表」中间位置的一行字母。

examples.en: The clinic uses a Snellen chart with black letters on a white background.
examples.zh: 诊所用的是白底黑字的「斯内伦视力表」。

collocations: the bottom row of a Snellen chart

words.enDefinition: a test measuring the area someone can see while looking ahead

examples.en: The report from my visual field test included a diagram for each eye.
examples.zh: 我的「视野检查」报告给每只眼睛各附了一张图。

examples.en: The assistant explained how long the visual field test would take that morning.
examples.zh: 助理说明了那天上午的「视野检查」要花多长时间。

words.enDefinition: what someone sees toward the edges of their field of view

examples.en: The clinician asked whether I had noticed any change in my peripheral vision lately.
examples.zh: 医务人员问我最近有没有觉得「周边视野」发生变化。

examples.en: The small light appeared in my peripheral vision while I looked straight ahead.
examples.zh: 我直视前方时，有个小亮点出现在我的「周边视野」里。

words.enDefinition: sight directly ahead where someone is looking

examples.en: The optometrist asked whether the change in my central vision was noticeable during reading.
examples.zh: 验光师问我，阅读时是否能察觉「中心视力」有变化。

examples.en: The report described central vision and peripheral vision in two separate sections.
examples.zh: 报告分成两部分，分别描述「中心视力」和周边视野。

words.enDefinition: a test of how well someone can distinguish different colors

examples.en: The color vision test used pages filled with dots in different shades.
examples.zh: 「色觉测试」用的每一页上都布满了不同颜色的圆点。

examples.en: I asked the clinic whether the color vision test was part of my appointment.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，这次预约是否包括「色觉测试」。

collocations: results from a color vision test

words.enDefinition: the ability to judge how far away objects are

examples.en: The optometrist explained what the simple pictures could show about my depth perception.
examples.zh: 验光师解释，这些简单图案能反映我的「深度知觉」，也就是我判断距离的能力。

examples.en: I mentioned my depth perception when the clinician asked about judging distances outdoors.
examples.zh: 医务人员问我在室外怎么判断远近，我提到了自己的「深度知觉」。

words.enDefinition: how well someone distinguishes objects from similar backgrounds

examples.en: I asked what contrast sensitivity meant when it appeared on the test report.
examples.zh: 我在检查报告上看到「对比敏感度」，就问了这个词的意思。

examples.en: The examiner used several rows of pale letters to record my contrast sensitivity.
examples.zh: 检查人员用好几行浅色字母来记录我的「对比敏感度」。

words.enDefinition: how a pupil changes in response to light or another stimulus

examples.en: The clinician recorded the pupil response to light during the first part of the exam.
examples.zh: 检查刚开始时，医务人员记录了「瞳孔对光的反应」。

examples.en: I asked what the note about pupil response meant in the test summary.
examples.zh: 我问检查摘要里关于「瞳孔反应」的那条记录是什么意思。

collocations: record the pupil response to light

words.enDefinition: an eye examination with widened pupils to see internal structures

examples.en: I booked a dilated eye exam after checking the available dates with the clinic.
examples.zh: 我与诊所核对了可约日期，然后预约了「散瞳眼部检查」。

examples.en: The ophthalmologist explained the images taken during my dilated eye exam the previous week.
examples.zh: 眼科医生解释了上周「散瞳眼部检查」时拍下的影像。

collocations: results of a dilated eye exam

words.enDefinition: making images of the light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye

examples.en: The clinic explained how long the retinal imaging appointment would take that afternoon.
examples.zh: 诊所说明了当天下午的「视网膜成像」预约需要多长时间。

examples.en: I asked the specialist where the retinal imaging results would appear in my record.
examples.zh: 我问专科医生，「视网膜成像」的结果会显示在我的记录哪个位置。

words.enDefinition: a picture showing the retina at the back of an eye

examples.en: The doctor put my retinal photograph on the screen next to an older image.
examples.zh: 医生把我的「视网膜照片」和一张较早的影像并排放在屏幕上。

examples.en: I asked for a copy of the retinal photograph to take to my next appointment.
examples.zh: 我要了一份「视网膜照片」的副本，打算下次就诊时带去。

words.enDefinition: a scan using light to show cross-sections of tissue

examples.en: The technician explained how long the OCT scan of my retina would take.
examples.zh: 技术人员说明了我的视网膜「光学相干断层扫描」需要多长时间。

examples.en: The ophthalmologist compared the OCT scan with one taken at another clinic.
examples.zh: 眼科医生把这次的「光学相干断层扫描」和另一家诊所拍的对照了一下。

collocations: an OCT scan of the retina
the results of an OCT scan

words.enDefinition: an eye exam using a lit microscope to see structures closely

examples.en: I asked what slit-lamp examination meant on the list of planned tests.
examples.zh: 我问了检查项目单上的「裂隙灯检查」是什么意思。

examples.en: The optometrist talked me through the results of the slit-lamp examination afterward.
examples.zh: 「裂隙灯检查」结束后，验光师逐条给我解释了结果。

words.enDefinition: the pressure inside the eye

examples.en: The clinician recorded my eye pressure on the same page as my other results.
examples.zh: 医务人员把我的「眼压」和其他检查结果记在了同一页上。

examples.en: I asked whether both eye pressure readings were included in the printout.
examples.zh: 我问打印出来的报告上是不是有双眼的「眼压」读数。

words.enDefinition: a check using a brief puff of air to estimate eye pressure

examples.en: The technician told me the air puff test was on the list for today.
examples.zh: 技术人员告诉我，「吹气测眼压检查」是今天的项目之一。

examples.en: I asked whether the air puff test would be done in a separate room.
examples.zh: 我问「吹气测眼压检查」会不会在另一个房间做。

collocations: results from the air puff test

words.enDefinition: how well the two eyes point in the same direction

examples.en: The clinician wrote down the results for eye alignment in my exam notes.
examples.zh: 医务人员在检查记录里记下了「双眼对位」的结果。

examples.en: I asked what the comment about eye alignment meant before leaving the clinic.
examples.zh: 离开诊所前，我问了关于「双眼对位」的那条备注是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a test to determine which lens powers help vision focus

examples.en: During the refraction test, I described which set of lenses made the letters clearer.
examples.zh: 「验光检查」时，我比较了两种镜片下哪个看字母更清楚。

examples.en: I asked for the refraction test results so I could compare them with my old prescription.
examples.zh: 我要了「验光检查」的结果，好和原来的处方对照。

collocations: the results of the refraction test

words.enDefinition: an instrument that estimates the eye's focusing error

examples.en: The technician recorded the numbers from the autorefractor before I saw the optometrist.
examples.zh: 我见验光师之前，技术人员记下了「自动验光仪」显示的数字。

examples.en: I asked whether the printout from the autorefractor belonged in my record.
examples.zh: 我问这张「自动验光仪」打印单是否要放进我的档案。

words.enDefinition: an instrument with selectable test lenses for checking refraction

examples.en: The optometrist changed the lenses in the phoropter while I looked at the chart.
examples.zh: 我看着视力表时，验光师切换了「综合验光仪」里的镜片。

examples.en: I had not seen a phoropter until my appointment at the optical shop.
examples.zh: 在眼镜店做检查之前，我没见过「综合验光仪」。

words.enDefinition: a focusing problem that prevents light from forming a clear image

examples.en: The optometrist explained the term refractive error after showing me the printed report.
examples.zh: 验光师给我看了打印出的报告，然后解释了「屈光不正」这个词。

examples.en: I asked where the refractive error was recorded for each of my eyes.
examples.zh: 我问每只眼睛的「屈光不正」记录在报告的什么位置。

words.enDefinition: a focusing condition in which faraway objects often look blurry

examples.en: My report listed myopia in both eyes, with a different measurement for each.
examples.zh: 我的报告写着两只眼睛都有「近视」，但测量结果不一样。

examples.en: The optometrist explained what myopia meant and showed me where it appeared in the notes.
examples.zh: 验光师解释了「近视」的意思，并指出它记录在什么位置。

words.enDefinition: a focusing condition often making close objects harder to see clearly

examples.en: I asked what hyperopia meant after seeing it on my new eye report.
examples.zh: 我在新的眼部检查报告上看到「远视」，就问了这个词的意思。

examples.en: The term hyperopia appeared below the results for the focusing test in my notes.
examples.zh: 我的记录里，聚焦测试结果下方写着「远视」。

words.enDefinition: a focusing error caused by uneven curvature of the cornea or lens

examples.en: The optometrist pointed out where astigmatism was recorded on the printed results sheet.
examples.zh: 验光师指出了打印结果单上记录「散光」的位置。

examples.en: I asked whether the figures for astigmatism were different in my two eyes.
examples.zh: 我问两只眼睛的「散光」数据是不是不一样。

words.enDefinition: age-related loss of the eye's ability to focus up close

examples.en: I saw the word presbyopia in the booklet we translated for the clinic.
examples.zh: 我在我们给诊所翻译的小册子里看到了「老视」这个词。

examples.en: The optometrist mentioned presbyopia when explaining the figures on my mother's glasses prescription.
examples.zh: 验光师给妈妈解释眼镜处方上的数字时，提到了「老视」。

words.enDefinition: a difference in refractive power between the two eyes

examples.en: The optometrist explained why the term anisometropia appeared alongside two different figures.
examples.zh: 验光师解释了为什么两个不同的数字旁边写着「屈光参差」。

examples.en: I asked the specialist whether anisometropia referred to the difference between my eyes.
examples.zh: 我问专科医生，「屈光参差」指的是不是我两只眼睛的差异。

words.enDefinition: difficulty distinguishing certain colors that others can tell apart

examples.en: I asked what color vision deficiency meant on the form from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问诊所表格上的「色觉缺陷」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clinician recorded color vision deficiency separately from the measurements of visual sharpness.
examples.zh: 医务人员把「色觉缺陷」和视敏度的测量结果分开记录。

collocations: a report noting color vision deficiency

words.enDefinition: vision formed when both eyes work together

examples.en: The examiner said the next part of the appointment would check binocular vision.
examples.zh: 检查人员说，就诊的下一个环节会检查「双眼视觉」。

examples.en: I asked where the results for binocular vision would appear in my online record.
examples.zh: 我问「双眼视觉」的结果会显示在网上记录的哪个位置。

words.enDefinition: the eye someone tends to favor for certain visual tasks

examples.en: The optometrist wrote down which was my dominant eye during the fitting appointment.
examples.zh: 配镜时，验光师记下我哪只眼睛是「主视眼」。

examples.en: I asked what dominant eye meant when I saw it on the information sheet.
examples.zh: 我在资料表上看到了「主视眼」，就问了这个词的意思。

words.enDefinition: a condition in which the eyes are not properly aligned

examples.en: The ophthalmologist noted my history of strabismus after reviewing the older clinic letters.
examples.zh: 眼科医生看过以前的诊所函件后，记下了我的「斜视」病史。

examples.en: I asked the specialist to explain the word strabismus on the referral sheet.
examples.zh: 我请专科医生解释转诊单上的「斜视」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: reduced vision that develops when the brain and eye do not work normally together

examples.en: The specialist asked whether amblyopia was mentioned in my childhood eye exam records.
examples.zh: 专科医生问，我小时候的眼部检查记录里有没有提到「弱视」。

examples.en: I found the word amblyopia in a clinic letter that my parents had kept.
examples.zh: 我在父母保存的一封诊所函件里找到了「弱视」这个词。

words.enDefinition: clouding of the natural lens inside the eye

examples.en: The ophthalmologist pointed to the note about the cataract in my grandfather's referral letter.
examples.zh: 眼科医生给爷爷指出了转诊信上关于「白内障」的备注。

examples.en: I asked the translator how to explain the word cataract to my grandmother.
examples.zh: 我问口译员该怎么向外婆解释「白内障」这个词。

words.enDefinition: a group of eye conditions that harm the optic nerve

examples.en: The clinic's questionnaire asked whether anyone in my family had a history of glaucoma.
examples.zh: 诊所问卷询问我家里有没有人有「青光眼」病史。

examples.en: I asked why glaucoma was mentioned on the information sheet accompanying the referral.
examples.zh: 我问随转诊单附上的资料为什么提到「青光眼」。

words.enDefinition: the light-sensitive tissue lining the back of the eye

examples.en: The doctor pointed to the retina on the diagram beside the exam chair.
examples.zh: 医生指着检查椅旁边示意图上的「视网膜」。

examples.en: I asked which parts of the retina were shown in the image on screen.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上的影像显示了「视网膜」的哪些部位。

words.enDefinition: the clear curved front surface of the eye

examples.en: The doctor used a simple diagram to show me where the cornea sits.
examples.zh: 医生用一张简单的图给我指了「角膜」的位置。

examples.en: I asked whether the notes about my cornea would go to the new clinic.
examples.zh: 我问有关「角膜」的记录会不会发给新诊所。

words.enDefinition: the nerve carrying visual signals from the eye to the brain

examples.en: The doctor showed me where the optic nerve appeared in the printed image.
examples.zh: 医生指给我看「视神经」在打印影像上的哪个位置。

examples.en: I asked what the comment about the optic nerve meant in the visit summary.
examples.zh: 我问就诊摘要里关于「视神经」的那条备注是什么意思。

collocations: the appearance of the optic nerve
an image of the optic nerve

words.enDefinition: a written record specifying lens correction for a pair of glasses

examples.en: I saved a copy of my glasses prescription before moving into student housing.
examples.zh: 搬进学生公寓前，我留存了一份「眼镜处方」的副本。

examples.en: The optical shop asked whether my glasses prescription was from the current year.
examples.zh: 眼镜店问我的「眼镜处方」是不是今年开的。

collocations: a copy of a glasses prescription

words.enDefinition: lens specifications for clear vision when looking far away

examples.en: I asked which line of the form contained my distance prescription for glasses.
examples.zh: 我问表格里哪一行写的是我的「远用眼镜处方」。

examples.en: The shop compared my distance prescription with the one I had used last year.
examples.zh: 眼镜店把我现在的「远用眼镜处方」和去年用过的那份对照了一下。

collocations: a change in the distance prescription
glasses made to a distance prescription

words.enDefinition: lens specifications for glasses used to see nearby text

examples.en: The optometrist printed a separate reading prescription and put it in my folder.
examples.zh: 验光师另外打印了一份「阅读眼镜处方」，放进我的文件夹。

examples.en: I asked whether my reading prescription was the one labeled for near work.
examples.zh: 我问标着近距离使用的那份是不是我的「阅读眼镜处方」。

collocations: glasses made to a reading prescription

words.enDefinition: a difference between new and previous optical prescription values

examples.en: I asked the optometrist to point out the prescription change on the form.
examples.zh: 我请验光师指出表格里的「处方度数变化」。

examples.en: The shop noticed a prescription change before preparing the quote for my new lenses.
examples.zh: 眼镜店在给我的新镜片报价前，发现了「处方度数变化」。

words.enDefinition: the strength with which a lens changes the focus of light

examples.en: The sample lens had its lens power printed in small letters on the sleeve.
examples.zh: 样品镜片的包装纸套上用小字标了「镜片度数」。

examples.en: I asked whether the lens power was the same for both of my eyes.
examples.zh: 我问我两只眼睛的「镜片度数」是不是一样。

words.enDefinition: lens power that is the same in every meridian

examples.en: The optometrist circled the spherical power in the first column of the form.
examples.zh: 验光师圈出了表格第一列的「球镜度数」。

examples.en: I asked where the spherical power was shown for my left eye on this copy.
examples.zh: 我问这份副本上左眼的「球镜度数」显示在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: the amount of lens correction for astigmatism

examples.en: The optometrist pointed to the cylinder power printed beside the sphere value.
examples.zh: 验光师指出了球镜数值旁边印的「柱镜度数」。

examples.en: I asked whether the cylinder power had changed since my appointment last year.
examples.zh: 我问和去年就诊时相比，「柱镜度数」有没有变化。

collocations: the cylinder power on a prescription

words.enDefinition: the orientation of the astigmatism correction on a lens prescription

examples.en: The form shows the cylinder axis in a column beside the cylinder power.
examples.zh: 表格里，「柱镜轴位」在柱镜度数旁边的一列。

examples.en: I asked the optometrist why the cylinder axis had a different symbol beside it.
examples.zh: 我问验光师为什么「柱镜轴位」旁边的符号不一样。

collocations: the cylinder axis for each eye

words.enDefinition: extra lens power specified for reading or other near work

examples.en: The optometrist showed my mother where the reading addition was printed on her prescription.
examples.zh: 验光师指出了妈妈处方上「近用附加度数」的印刷位置。

examples.en: I asked what the reading addition meant in the form we were translating.
examples.zh: 我问我们正在翻译的表格上，「近用附加度数」是什么意思。

collocations: a reading addition on the prescription

words.enDefinition: the unit used to express the focusing power of a lens

examples.en: I asked what a diopter meant after seeing the letter D on my report.
examples.zh: 我在报告上看到了字母 D，就问「屈光度」是什么意思。

examples.en: The leaflet described a diopter in a section explaining the numbers on a prescription.
examples.zh: 小册子在解释处方数字的部分介绍了「屈光度」。

words.enDefinition: an optical correction that shifts where an image appears

examples.en: I asked which part of the prescription showed the prism correction for my glasses.
examples.zh: 我问处方的哪部分写的是我眼镜的「棱镜矫正」。

examples.en: The optometrist explained why prism correction has an entry separate from lens power.
examples.zh: 验光师解释了为什么「棱镜矫正」和镜片度数分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the direction the thicker edge of a corrective prism faces

examples.en: The form listed the prism base in words instead of using a number.
examples.zh: 表格用文字标注了「棱镜基底方向」，没有用数字。

examples.en: I asked which of the arrows indicated the prism base on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我问图上哪个箭头标的是「棱镜基底方向」。

collocations: the direction of the prism base

words.enDefinition: the distance between the centers of the pupils

examples.en: The optician measured my pupillary distance after I chose a pair of frames.
examples.zh: 我选定一副镜框后，配镜师给我量了「瞳距」。

examples.en: I asked whether my pupillary distance was recorded on the receipt or the form.
examples.zh: 我问「瞳距」是记在收据上还是表格上。

words.enDefinition: the distance from the center of one pupil to the nose bridge midline

examples.en: The optician wrote two values for monocular pupillary distance on the fitting sheet.
examples.zh: 配镜师在配镜单上写了两个「单眼瞳距」数值。

examples.en: I asked why my monocular pupillary distance had a separate measurement for each eye.
examples.zh: 我问为什么两只眼睛的「单眼瞳距」要分别测量。

words.enDefinition: put on eyeglass frames to see how they fit or look

examples.en: I stopped at the optical shop to try on frames after my lecture.
examples.zh: 下课后我顺路去眼镜店「试戴镜框」。

examples.en: The assistant gave me time to try on frames without making a decision.
examples.zh: 店员给了我时间慢慢「试戴镜框」，不用马上决定。

words.enDefinition: the horizontal measurement from one side of a frame to the other

examples.en: The frame width on this pair was close to that of my old glasses.
examples.zh: 这一副的「镜框总宽」和我的旧眼镜差不多。

examples.en: I asked where the frame width was listed on the shop's website.
examples.zh: 我问商店的网站把「镜框总宽」标在了哪里。

words.enDefinition: the horizontal measurement across one lens opening in a frame

examples.en: I compared the lens width of both pairs before choosing the smaller frame.
examples.zh: 我先比较了两副眼镜的「单片镜片宽度」，才选了较小的镜框。

examples.en: The assistant pointed to the lens width printed inside the frame's arm.
examples.zh: 店员指出了镜腿内侧印着的「单片镜片宽度」。

collocations: a frame with a narrower lens width

words.enDefinition: the frame measurement across the gap between the two lenses

examples.en: The optician wrote down the bridge width before showing me another frame.
examples.zh: 配镜师先记下「鼻梁架宽度」，再给我看另一款镜框。

examples.en: Online, the bridge width was listed beside two other frame measurements.
examples.zh: 网上把「鼻梁架宽度」和另外两个镜框尺寸列在了一起。

collocations: the bridge width on a frame

words.enDefinition: the length of the frame's side arm reaching behind the ear

examples.en: The temple length was printed on the inside of my old frames.
examples.zh: 我的旧镜框内侧印着「镜腿长度」。

examples.en: I asked the assistant to compare the temple length of the two pairs.
examples.zh: 我请店员比较这两副眼镜的「镜腿长度」。

collocations: the temple length printed on the frame

words.enDefinition: small supports resting against the sides of the nose

examples.en: The optician showed me how these nose pads differed from the ones on my old glasses.
examples.zh: 配镜师给我看了这款「眼镜鼻托」和旧眼镜上的有何不同。

examples.en: I asked whether the nose pads were included in the price of the frame.
examples.zh: 我问镜框的价格是否包括「眼镜鼻托」。

words.enDefinition: a joint connecting a glasses arm to the front frame

examples.en: The optician examined the frame hinge after I brought in my damaged glasses.
examples.zh: 我带来损坏的眼镜后，配镜师检查了「镜架铰链」。

examples.en: The assistant pointed out the frame hinge when I asked which part could be replaced.
examples.zh: 我问哪个零件能换，店员给我指出了「镜架铰链」。

words.enDefinition: glasses joints with springs that let the arms flex outward

examples.en: The assistant brought out a pair of glasses fitted with spring hinges.
examples.zh: 店员拿出一副装有「弹簧铰链」的眼镜。

examples.en: The product page listed spring hinges under the frame features and included a photograph.
examples.zh: 商品页在镜框特点中列出了「弹簧铰链」，还附了一张照片。

words.enDefinition: a change to how a glasses frame fits the wearer

examples.en: I asked about a frame adjustment when the new glasses felt uneven.
examples.zh: 新眼镜戴起来一边高一边低，我就问能不能做「镜框调整」。

examples.en: The optician included a frame adjustment in the appointment after my classes finished.
examples.zh: 我下课后去配镜，那次预约还包含一次「镜框调整」。

words.enDefinition: new lenses fitted to take the place of old ones

examples.en: I asked for a quote for replacement lenses without buying a new frame.
examples.zh: 我问能不能不买新镜框，只给「替换镜片」报个价。

examples.en: The shop sent me a message when the replacement lenses were ready.
examples.zh: 「替换镜片」备好后，店里给我发了消息。

words.enDefinition: the point on a spectacle lens with no prismatic deviation

examples.en: The optician marked the optical center on a sketch of the sample lens.
examples.zh: 配镜师在样品镜片的示意图上标出了「光学中心」。

examples.en: I asked what the optical center meant on the fitting form for my new glasses.
examples.zh: 我问新眼镜配镜表上的「光学中心」是什么意思。

collocations: check the optical center of a lens

words.enDefinition: the distance between a lens's front and back surfaces

examples.en: The optician showed me how the lens thickness differed across the three samples.
examples.zh: 配镜师向我展示了这三种样品的「镜片厚度」有何不同。

examples.en: I asked about lens thickness because my previous pair had felt heavy.
examples.zh: 我上一副眼镜戴起来有点重，所以问了一下「镜片厚度」。

words.enDefinition: eyeglass lenses made of a lightweight impact-resistant plastic

examples.en: The shop showed me where polycarbonate lenses were listed on the price sheet.
examples.zh: 眼镜店给我指出了价目表上「聚碳酸酯镜片」所在的位置。

examples.en: I asked how the price of polycarbonate lenses compared with the standard option.
examples.zh: 我问「聚碳酸酯镜片」的价格和标准选项相比如何。

words.enDefinition: lenses made from a material that bends light more strongly

examples.en: The optician brought out a sample of high-index lenses beside the standard lenses.
examples.zh: 配镜师拿出「高折射率镜片」的样品，摆在标准镜片旁边。

examples.en: I saved the quote for high-index lenses to compare with another shop later.
examples.zh: 我保留了「高折射率镜片」的报价，打算之后和另一家店比较。

words.enDefinition: lenses with a surface whose curvature varies across it

examples.en: I asked the optician what aspheric lenses meant on the printed comparison sheet.
examples.zh: 我问配镜师，打印的对比表上「非球面镜片」是什么意思。

examples.en: The shop listed the price for aspheric lenses in a separate column.
examples.zh: 商店把「非球面镜片」的价格单列了一栏。

words.enDefinition: glasses frames with no rims around the lenses

examples.en: The rimless frames felt lighter than the pair I had tried earlier.
examples.zh: 这副「无框眼镜架」感觉比我之前试的那副轻。

examples.en: I asked to see rimless frames with a bridge similar to my old pair.
examples.zh: 我想看看鼻梁处和旧眼镜类似的「无框眼镜架」。

words.enDefinition: glasses frames with rims only partly surrounding each lens

examples.en: The assistant showed me semi-rimless frames in several colors near the mirror.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了镜子附近陈列的几种颜色的「半框眼镜架」。

examples.en: I compared two pairs of semi-rimless frames before choosing the darker one.
examples.zh: 我比较了两副「半框眼镜架」，才选了颜色更深的那副。

words.enDefinition: glasses frames with rims completely surrounding both lenses

examples.en: The shop had full-rim frames in several widths on the same display.
examples.zh: 同一个展示架上摆着好几种宽度的「全框眼镜架」。

examples.en: I chose full-rim frames with a color that matched my everyday clothes.
examples.zh: 我选了一副颜色和日常衣服很搭的「全框眼镜架」。

words.enDefinition: glasses frames made of a plastic called cellulose acetate

examples.en: I found acetate frames in the same color as my old glasses.
examples.zh: 我找到一副和旧眼镜同色的「醋酸纤维素镜架」。

examples.en: The shop explained why these acetate frames cost more than the basic pair.
examples.zh: 店里解释了这副「醋酸纤维素镜架」为什么比基础款贵。

words.enDefinition: sunglasses made with lenses that correct the wearer's vision

examples.en: I asked how long it would take to make a pair of prescription sunglasses.
examples.zh: 我问配一副「有度数的太阳镜」要多久。

examples.en: The shop sent two quotes, one for glasses and one for prescription sunglasses.
examples.zh: 店里给了两份报价，一份是眼镜，一份是「有度数的太阳镜」。

words.enDefinition: tinted attachments that clip onto a pair of regular glasses

examples.en: The shop measured my frames before showing me a pair of clip-on sunglasses.
examples.zh: 店员先量了我的镜框，才给我看一副「夹片式太阳镜」。

examples.en: The clip-on sunglasses came in a small pouch separate from the glasses.
examples.zh: 「夹片式太阳镜」有个单独的小袋子，没和眼镜装在一起。

words.enDefinition: a layer on lenses designed to reduce surface reflections

examples.en: The optician showed me a lens sample with an anti-reflective coating in the shop.
examples.zh: 配镜师在店里给我看了一片带「减反射镀膜」的样品镜片。

examples.en: The anti-reflective coating appeared as a separate option on the printed quote.
examples.zh: 打印出的报价单把「减反射镀膜」列为单独的选项。

collocations: a quote for an anti-reflective coating

words.enDefinition: a surface layer that helps protect a lens from scratches

examples.en: I asked whether the lens price already included a scratch-resistant coating on both sides.
examples.zh: 我问镜片的价格是否已经包含双面的「耐刮镀膜」。

examples.en: The brochure compared the standard scratch-resistant coating with the premium coating option.
examples.zh: 小册子对比了标准「耐刮镀膜」和高端镀膜选项。

words.enDefinition: a feature that reduces exposure to ultraviolet light

examples.en: I looked for information about UV protection on the sunglasses tag before asking the assistant.
examples.zh: 询问店员之前，我先在太阳镜吊牌上找了「紫外线防护」信息。

examples.en: The brochure lists UV protection separately from the color of the lens.
examples.zh: 小册子把「紫外线防护」和镜片颜色分开列出。

words.enDefinition: lenses with a filter that reduces some reflected glare

examples.en: I tried on sunglasses with polarized lenses while looking out the shop window.
examples.zh: 我试戴了配「偏光镜片」的太阳镜，朝商店窗外看了看。

examples.en: The assistant used a display to show how polarized lenses differed from standard tinted ones.
examples.zh: 店员用展示装置演示了「偏光镜片」与普通染色镜片的区别。

words.enDefinition: lenses colored to change the amount or tone of transmitted light

examples.en: I compared the two pairs of tinted lenses near the window at the shop.
examples.zh: 我在店里窗边对照看了两副「有色镜片」。

examples.en: The catalogue lists tinted lenses in several shades next to the clear options.
examples.zh: 商品目录在透明款旁边列了几种不同深浅的「有色镜片」。

words.enDefinition: lenses that darken and then lighten in response to changes in light exposure, typically ultraviolet light

examples.en: I asked how photochromic lenses differed from the tinted option on the quote.
examples.zh: 我问「变色镜片」和报价单上的染色镜片有什么不同。

examples.en: The leaflet showed photochromic lenses indoors and outdoors in two separate pictures.
examples.zh: 小册子用两张图分别展示了「变色镜片」在室内和室外的样子。

words.enDefinition: eyeglass lenses with one optical prescription across the viewing area

examples.en: The assistant explained why the first quote was for single-vision lenses only.
examples.zh: 店员解释了为什么第一份报价只包含「单光镜片」。

examples.en: I asked whether single-vision lenses were listed on the receipt for my glasses.
examples.zh: 我问眼镜收据上是否标了「单光镜片」。

words.enDefinition: lenses with two distinct areas for different viewing distances

examples.en: I saw a visible line on the sample pair of bifocal lenses.
examples.zh: 我在那副「双光镜片」样品上看到了明显的分界线。

examples.en: The optician showed my father where bifocal lenses appeared on the price sheet.
examples.zh: 配镜师给父亲指出了价目表上的「双光镜片」。

words.enDefinition: lenses with three distinct areas for different viewing distances

examples.en: The display included trifocal lenses alongside the other options with visible segments.
examples.zh: 展示台把「三光镜片」和其他有明显分区的选项放在了一起。

examples.en: I asked the optician to explain the lines on the sample trifocal lenses.
examples.zh: 我请配镜师解释「三光镜片」样品上的分界线。

words.enDefinition: eyeglass lenses whose optical power changes gradually across viewing regions

examples.en: The optician used a diagram to show how progressive lenses changed across the surface.
examples.zh: 配镜师用图说明了「渐进多焦点镜片」的度数如何沿镜片表面变化。

examples.en: I asked whether progressive lenses and varifocals meant the same thing in the catalogue.
examples.zh: 我问目录里的「渐进多焦点镜片」和 varifocals 指的是不是同一种镜片。

words.enDefinition: glasses intended to make nearby text easier to see

examples.en: My mother left her reading glasses beside the books she had brought.
examples.zh: 妈妈把「阅读眼镜」落在了她带来的几本书旁边。

examples.en: The shop displayed reading glasses next to the cases and cleaning cloths.
examples.zh: 眼镜店把「阅读眼镜」陈列在眼镜盒和擦镜布旁边。

collocations: use reading glasses for close work

words.enDefinition: noncustom reading glasses sold in standard lens strengths

examples.en: The pharmacy had a stand of ready-made reading glasses beside the main counter.
examples.zh: 药房主柜台旁摆着一架「成品阅读眼镜」。

examples.en: I asked how the label on ready-made reading glasses differed from my prescription.
examples.zh: 我问「成品阅读眼镜」的标签和我的处方有什么区别。

collocations: a display of ready-made reading glasses

words.enDefinition: lenses designed around visual distances needed for particular work tasks

examples.en: The optician asked about my workspace before showing the samples of occupational lenses.
examples.zh: 配镜师先问了我的工作环境，再给我看「职业用镜片」的样品。

examples.en: The price sheet listed occupational lenses separately from standard reading glasses.
examples.zh: 价目表把「职业用镜片」和普通阅读眼镜分开列出。

words.enDefinition: protective glasses that also contain a corrective lens prescription

examples.en: I asked the laboratory office where I could order prescription safety glasses.
examples.zh: 我问实验室办公室，可以在哪里订购「有度数的防护眼镜」。

examples.en: The shop sent me an estimate for prescription safety glasses with the chosen frame.
examples.zh: 商店发来了选定镜框的「有度数的防护眼镜」报价。

collocations: a quote for prescription safety glasses

words.enDefinition: a rigid container for protecting a pair of glasses

examples.en: I kept my glasses in a hard glasses case inside my backpack.
examples.zh: 我把眼镜放进「硬壳眼镜盒」，再收进背包。

examples.en: The optical shop included a hard glasses case in the price of the frame.
examples.zh: 眼镜店把一个「硬壳眼镜盒」算在了镜框价格里。

collocations: put glasses in a hard glasses case

words.enDefinition: a soft cloth made for cleaning the surface of lenses

examples.en: The assistant put a lens cloth in the box with my glasses.
examples.zh: 店员把一块「擦镜布」和我的眼镜一起放进了盒里。

examples.en: I found the lens cloth inside the spare case I keep at my desk.
examples.zh: 我在书桌上备用的眼镜盒里找到了「擦镜布」。

words.enDefinition: an extra pair kept in case the main one is unavailable

examples.en: I left a spare pair of glasses in my room before going abroad.
examples.zh: 出国之前，我在房间里留了「备用的一副」眼镜。

examples.en: The assistant asked if my old glasses would still work as a spare pair.
examples.zh: 店员问我的旧眼镜能不能继续当「备用的一副」。

collocations: take a spare pair on a trip

words.enDefinition: a promise covering certain faults in a glasses frame

examples.en: I asked whether the frame warranty was printed on the back of my receipt.
examples.zh: 我问收据背面是不是印了「镜框保修」条款。

examples.en: The assistant looked up the frame warranty when I brought the glasses back.
examples.zh: 我把眼镜带回店里时，店员查了「镜框保修」条款。

words.enDefinition: lenses with marks caused by something scraping the surface

examples.en: The optician examined my scratched lenses under a light at the counter.
examples.zh: 配镜师在柜台的灯光下检查了我「有划痕的镜片」。

examples.en: I brought my old pair with scratched lenses to ask about replacing them.
examples.zh: 我带上旧眼镜，问能不能把「有划痕的镜片」换掉。

words.enDefinition: glasses repeatedly move downward out of their intended position

examples.en: I told the optician that my glasses keep slipping when I look down.
examples.zh: 我告诉配镜师，我一低头，「眼镜就老往下滑」。

examples.en: My glasses keep slipping during lectures, so I asked about the frame fit.
examples.zh: 上课时我的「眼镜老往下滑」，我就问是不是镜框不合适。

collocations: explain why my glasses keep slipping

words.enDefinition: frames press uncomfortably against the sides of the nose

examples.en: These frames pinch my nose after an hour, even though they looked fine.
examples.zh: 这副眼镜看着没问题，可戴一小时后「镜框就夹得我鼻子疼」。

examples.en: I told the optician the frames pinch my nose on the right side.
examples.zh: 我告诉配镜师，这副「镜框夹得我鼻子右侧疼」。

collocations: notice the frames pinch my nose
say the frames pinch my nose

words.enDefinition: an appointment to assess whether particular contact lenses fit the eyes

examples.en: I booked a contact lens fitting at the same clinic as my eye exam.
examples.zh: 我在做眼部检查的同一家诊所预约了「隐形眼镜验配」。

examples.en: The reception team explained how long the contact lens fitting would take that afternoon.
examples.zh: 前台工作人员说了当天下午的「隐形眼镜验配」大概要多久。

words.enDefinition: a visit to review contact lens fit and eye health

examples.en: I moved my contact lens check to a day when I had no lectures.
examples.zh: 我把「隐形眼镜复查」改到了没有课的一天。

examples.en: The clinic sent me a reminder for a contact lens check next month.
examples.zh: 诊所发来一条提醒，告诉我下个月有一次「隐形眼镜复查」。

collocations: have a routine contact lens check

words.enDefinition: sample contact lenses provided for evaluating the fit and vision

examples.en: The optometrist pointed out which box contained the trial contact lenses for my appointment.
examples.zh: 验光师给我指出了哪个盒子里装着本次预约的「试戴隐形眼镜」。

examples.en: I asked whether the trial contact lenses appeared on the itemized receipt.
examples.zh: 我问明细收据上是否列有「试戴隐形眼镜」。

collocations: a pack of trial contact lenses

words.enDefinition: a written specification of lenses fitted to the wearer's eyes

examples.en: I asked for a copy of my contact lens prescription before leaving the clinic.
examples.zh: 离开诊所前，我要了一份「隐形眼镜处方」副本。

examples.en: The shop asked whether I had a contact lens prescription on file.
examples.zh: 店员问我的「隐形眼镜处方」有没有存档。

collocations: a copy of a contact lens prescription

words.enDefinition: contact lenses made of flexible materials that bend easily

examples.en: The optometrist showed me a sample package of soft contact lenses during my visit.
examples.zh: 就诊时，验光师给我看了一盒「软性隐形眼镜」的样品。

examples.en: I asked whether soft contact lenses were listed on my previous prescription.
examples.zh: 我问自己上一张处方上写的是不是「软性隐形眼镜」。

collocations: a fitting for soft contact lenses
a package of soft contact lenses

words.enDefinition: firm contact lenses made of material that allows oxygen through

examples.en: The leaflet explained how rigid gas-permeable lenses differ from the soft kind.
examples.zh: 小册子介绍了「硬性透气隐形眼镜」和软性隐形眼镜的区别。

examples.en: I asked why rigid gas-permeable lenses were listed separately on the clinic website.
examples.zh: 我问诊所网站为什么把「硬性透气隐形眼镜」单独列出来。

collocations: a fitting for rigid gas-permeable lenses
a leaflet on rigid gas-permeable lenses

words.enDefinition: contact lenses designed with different powers to correct astigmatism

examples.en: The optometrist showed me where toric contact lenses appeared on the comparison sheet.
examples.zh: 验光师给我指出了对比表上的「散光隐形眼镜」选项。

examples.en: I asked whether the quote included toric contact lenses for both eyes.
examples.zh: 我问报价是否包括两个眼睛的「散光隐形眼镜」。

collocations: a fitting for toric contact lenses
a box of toric contact lenses

words.enDefinition: contact lenses with different optical powers for different viewing distances

examples.en: The handout listed multifocal contact lenses in a different section from standard lenses.
examples.zh: 资料把「多焦点隐形眼镜」和标准款分在不同部分。

examples.en: I asked the optometrist who I could contact about the quote for multifocal contact lenses.
examples.zh: 我问验光师，「多焦点隐形眼镜」的报价可以向谁咨询。

collocations: a fitting for multifocal contact lenses
a quote for multifocal contact lenses

words.enDefinition: single-use contact lenses designed for one day's wear

examples.en: The optical shop stocked daily disposable lenses in boxes of several sizes.
examples.zh: 眼镜店的「日抛隐形眼镜」有几种不同大小的盒装规格。

examples.en: I looked up the price of daily disposable lenses before asking for a quote.
examples.zh: 询价前，我先查了「日抛隐形眼镜」的价格。

collocations: a pack of daily disposable lenses
an order for daily disposable lenses

words.enDefinition: contact lenses designed to be replaced according to a two-week cycle

examples.en: The brochure lists two-week contact lenses separately from the daily disposable range.
examples.zh: 小册子把「双周抛隐形眼镜」和日抛系列分开列出。

examples.en: I asked whether the quote for two-week contact lenses included the fitting fee.
examples.zh: 我问「双周抛隐形眼镜」的报价是否已包含验配费。

collocations: a pack of two-week contact lenses
a quote for two-week contact lenses

words.enDefinition: contact lenses designed for a monthly replacement cycle

examples.en: I asked whether monthly contact lenses were available in the brand on my prescription.
examples.zh: 我问处方上的牌子有没有「月抛隐形眼镜」。

examples.en: The assistant found a quote for monthly contact lenses in the shop's system.
examples.zh: 店员在商店系统里找到了「月抛隐形眼镜」的报价。

collocations: a box of monthly contact lenses

words.enDefinition: a measurement describing the curvature of the inner side of a contact lens

examples.en: I asked where the contact lens base curve appeared on the printed form.
examples.zh: 我问打印表格上的「隐形眼镜基弧」标在哪里。

examples.en: The optometrist pointed out the contact lens base curve on the side of the box.
examples.zh: 验光师指出了盒子侧面标注的「隐形眼镜基弧」。

collocations: check the contact lens base curve
the printed contact lens base curve
record a contact lens base curve

words.enDefinition: the measurement from one edge of a contact lens to the opposite edge

examples.en: The contact lens diameter was printed beside the other measurements on the label.
examples.zh: 「隐形眼镜直径」印在标签上，就在其他尺寸旁边。

examples.en: I asked if the contact lens diameter should appear on both pages of the report.
examples.zh: 我问报告的两页上是否都应标注「隐形眼镜直径」。

collocations: the contact lens diameter on the prescription

words.enDefinition: the substance from which a particular contact lens is made

examples.en: The optometrist pointed to the contact lens material listed on the box.
examples.zh: 验光师指出了盒子上标注的「隐形眼镜材质」。

examples.en: I asked where I could find the contact lens material in the product description.
examples.zh: 我问在商品说明的哪里能找到「隐形眼镜材质」。

collocations: a leaflet about contact lens material

words.enDefinition: the planned frequency for replacing an item such as contact lenses

examples.en: I asked the optometrist where the replacement schedule was written on the information sheet.
examples.zh: 我问验光师，资料单上的「更换周期」写在哪儿。

examples.en: The brochure lists the replacement schedule separately from the price of each box.
examples.zh: 小册子把「更换周期」和每盒的价格分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the schedule describing when and how long a device is meant to be worn

examples.en: I asked whether the wearing schedule would appear in the notes from my optometrist.
examples.zh: 我问验光师给的记录里会不会写「佩戴时间安排」。

examples.en: The optometrist wrote the wearing schedule on a separate page of the handout.
examples.zh: 验光师把「佩戴时间安排」写在资料的另一页上。

words.enDefinition: an individual sealed pocket holding a contact lens

examples.en: The assistant showed me the information printed on the contact lens blister.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了「隐形眼镜独立泡罩」上印的信息。

examples.en: I asked where the product name appeared on the contact lens blister.
examples.zh: 我问「隐形眼镜独立泡罩」的哪个位置写了产品名称。

collocations: the label on a contact lens blister

words.enDefinition: a small container with compartments for storing contact lenses

examples.en: The optical shop had a travel contact lens case next to the register.
examples.zh: 眼镜店收银台旁放了一个旅行用的「隐形眼镜盒」。

examples.en: My roommate found her contact lens case in the side pocket of her bag.
examples.zh: 室友在包的侧袋里找到了自己的「隐形眼镜盒」。

collocations: the lid of a contact lens case

words.enDefinition: a liquid formulated for contact lens care or storage

examples.en: I showed the optician the label on my bottle of contact lens solution.
examples.zh: 我给配镜师看了我那瓶「隐形眼镜护理液」上的标签。

examples.en: The pharmacy moved the contact lens solution to the shelf beside the cases.
examples.zh: 药房把「隐形眼镜护理液」挪到了隐形眼镜盒旁边的架子上。

collocations: a bottle of contact lens solution
the label on contact lens solution

words.enDefinition: an unpleasant sensation associated with wearing contact lenses

examples.en: I described the contact lens discomfort when the optometrist asked about my experience.
examples.zh: 验光师问我佩戴感受时，我描述了「戴隐形眼镜时的不适」。

examples.en: The clinic's questionnaire asked when I first noticed contact lens discomfort that week.
examples.zh: 诊所问卷问我那周最早是什么时候觉得「戴隐形眼镜不舒服」。

collocations: a history of contact lens discomfort
